entry.summary:

entry.summary:

entry.title: Chefsläkaren: ”Det var ett systemfel”

entry.title: Hård oppositionskritik efter beslut om fiskekvoterna: ”Obegripligt”

entry.title: Comet C/2023 A3 brightens SOHO’s week
entry.summary:
Video: 00:00:23
From 7 until 13 October 2024, ESA/NASA’s SOHO spacecraft recorded Comet C/2023 A3 (Tsuchinshan–ATLAS), the second brightest comet it has ever seen. Meanwhile, large amounts of material were being spewed out by the Sun (covered in the centre), and planet Mercury is visible to the left. The comet’s nucleus is clearly visible, surrounded by a dusty coma and trailing an impressively long tail. SOHO sees the large dust tail edge-on, curving in on itself as it is pushed outward by solar wind. At the end of the video you can also see a rare phenomenon known as an ‘anti-tail’: a long, thin line that points towards the Sun.
